checks.detail: Reviewed candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD. Runtime: both receipts bind source sha 72467d3e17230fdbf4d8801fdff67c8ea5a7767336ee48e831ccc47f8b00a774 with fresh builds, all blocking checks true, source_unchanged and native_candidate_matches true. Interface and visuals: I judged all 13 bound pixel captures against PRD 8/9/9.1 — six signed-in surfaces in two independent drives show calm editorial hierarchy, restrained accent, icon+text navigation, board columns, month calendar, focus history, and no prohibited patterns; the loop-21 compacted Settings now shows REMINDER DELIVERIES with a SENT delivery row and Send test email fully above the fold in both drives, and the anonymous replay shows a field-associated validation message with typed input preserved. Persistence: isolated identifier-derived store exists; captures show completed task, sent reminder, and session history after sign-out/sign-back-in. Security: tauri.conf.json (scheme, CSP, capabilities) untouched this loop; authz, rate limiting, and single-use token handling unit-proven; probe instrumentation is strictly opt-in, non-focusable, and never mutates startup state. Remaining gaps are measurement debt owned by named host follow-ups (external focusboard:// receipts, per-step section-3 receipt, recovery-journey captures, 9.2 fault-error and narrow-viewport captures) — carried as minor/note findings, not product failures. prd.section9.2=pass for the captured states; fault-error and narrow-viewport runtime captures=insufficient_evidence.

Verified in both layers on the frozen candidate. White-box (native.host.1): fresh rust-unit 50/50 includes register_verify_signin_quickadd_restart_persists (typed registration through sign-back-in with restart persistence), golden_path_section3_self_drive (pinned manifest covers PRD section 3 plus recovery), single-use/expired/reused recovery-token tests, generic-failure rate limiting, and private-operation authz rejection; tsc, vite build, cargo fmt/check all pass. Black-box (native.host.0/1): the host webdriver lane drove the anonymous smoke (invalid email rejected with a field-associated message, typed input preserved), triggered the advisory self-drive and observed it reach terminal pass 16/16 in 5.2s, then navigated and pixel-captured all six signed-in surfaces in two independent drives; the captures show durable post-sign-back-in state (completed task with strikethrough, reminder SENT with timestamp, focus session history, filtered-empty inbox split). The complete path is therefore verified white-box end-to-end and black-box at the host lane's capability ceiling; the missing per-step section-3 GUI receipt stays a host follow-up (find.first-run-gui-drive-missing, minor, insufficient_evidence) and does not convert into a product failure.

The real desktop product satisfies the complete Focusboard PRD with durable state and candidate-bound evidence. Every section-8 surface exists and is runtime-captured conformant to the section-9 direction in two independent host drives; the primary loop (capture, project assignment, scheduling, reminder delivery with SENT state and test-email action, focus session with history, completion, persistence across sign-out/sign-back-in) is visible in bound pixels and unit-proven end-to-end; recovery views, the deeplink ledger, and the 9.2 composer-failure and narrow-viewport states are delivered with white-box verification (opt-in isolated fault injection, preserved input, single-shot Retry, 760px task-row wrap rules), their remaining runtime receipts explicitly routed to named host follow-ups per the frozen rewrite_acceptance records in quality/evidence-acceptances.md. Zero open product defects remain after 21 loops of adversarial review; all open issues are measurement/infrastructure debt at minor/note severity with internal user impact. Accept.
